healthBenefits.title: Rich in Vitamin B12
healthBenefits.text: Mussels are one of the richest natural sources of vitamin B12, essential for nerve function and red blood cell formation.

healthBenefits.title: High-Quality Protein
healthBenefits.text: Mussels provide lean, complete protein that supports muscle repair and growth with minimal saturated fat.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil supplies monounsaturated fats and antioxidants that support cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
healthBenefits.text: Mussels contain omega-3s that contribute to brain function and help reduce inflammation.

healthBenefits.title: Immune Support
healthBenefits.text: Garlic contains allicin, a compound known for its antibacterial and immune-boosting properties.

healthBenefits.title: Good Source of Iron
healthBenefits.text: Mussels offer a notable amount of iron, important for oxygen transport and preventing fatigue.

_ingredientsText:
1 kg mussels
• 1 tablespoon chopped parsley
• 1 slice of stale bread
• 1 clove of garlic
• 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
• pepper (optional)
